mechanisms.rationale: Per-entry required-field validation + stderr error-severity diagnostic + skip-preservation in loadWorkspaceGates is ONE atomic behavior contract; the five entry-bearing gate arrays (it0/fixed/testPass/coverageFloor/redGreen) are call-site variants of the same validate-and-emit contract, not independent mechanisms. A strict subset (e.g. it0-only) cannot ship without violating the parent DIR-100 AC2 'every missing-required-field case across all five gate types emits a diagnostic'. The diagnostic channel (QUAY_GATE_DIAGNOSTICS) is DIR-100-C's separate mechanism and is explicitly out of this Proposal's scope. Production callsite proof surface: `gate --list` (packages/quay/bin/quay.ts:1114-1132) → listGates (packages/quay/src/gate/registry.ts:126-127) → loadWorkspaceGates.
